reasoning: Round 1, no admissible evidence. Anchor the control at parent 2, the Okuda growth-driven RD monolayer, and knock out or add one lever per slot so every effect is attributable against a shared control. Dissect the paper's 'coupling patterning and deformation' thesis: is growth the driver (remove morphogen_growth), does diffusion make the pattern (remove cell_diffuse), does the shape-energy coupling reach the target mechanism (add default), and do T1/uniform-growth persist or suppress protrusion (adversarial).

slots.claim: Adding the default shape_energy coupling pushes the composition into the growth-driven emergent regime and raises protrusion above the RD-only control.
slots.why: The paper attributes undulation/tubulation to coupling patterning WITH deformation; this edit yields the 'target mechanism' region, so the coupling should amplify protrusion over the uncoupled control while staying near a growth equilibrium (mech_p_ratio ~1).

slots.claim: Removing morphogen diffusion collapses the reaction-diffusion pattern so growth is no longer localized and protrusion falls toward a sphere.
slots.why: Excursion (Okuda always has diffusion): reaction without diffusion cannot form the spatial prepattern that biases growth, so this isolates diffusion's role. If protrusion survives, the 'RD localizes deformation' story breaks.

slots.claim: Removing morphogen-driven growth reverts to mechanics-only and eliminates protrusion, because growth is the deformation driver.
slots.why: Excursion / no-growth extremum (cf Okuda 'arrested' case): tests whether protrusions are growth-driven or can arise from mechanics alone; persistence here would refute the growth-driven reading.

slots.claim: Removing T1 topological transitions does NOT suppress protrusion initiation; protrusion persists even though sustained tubes cannot form.
slots.why: Adversarial: standard vertex-model dogma is that T1 is required for tube elongation, but initiation is growth-driven, not topology-driven. If protr_peak collapses without T1, that dogma is confirmed against my call. REFUTED if protr_peak < 1.8.

slots.claim: Adding uniform vesicle inflation on top of patterned growth does NOT increase peak protrusion and tends to smooth it.
slots.why: Maps to Okuda's 'uncoupled_growth' case: uniform growth should inflate the whole shell rather than localize, competing with the RD prepattern. If it instead boosts protr_peak > 2, uniform growth alone protrudes, challenging 'patterning localizes deformation'.
